name: medihelm
description: MediHelm — monorepo backend/ + frontend/. Orchestrateur de build Railway (Nixpacks) : l'application deployable est frontend/.

scripts.build: cd frontend && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build
scripts.start: cd frontend && (npx prisma migrate deploy || npx prisma db push --skip-generate) && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 NODE_ENV=production node .next/standalone/frontend/server.js
